name: Gel Bead Blaster (Colour-Shift Purple)
description: A 96 cm gel bead blaster in a purple-to-blue colour-shift finish, with an electric burst mode and a manual single-shot mode. The full kit adds a scope, red-dot sight, flashlight, laser, vertical grip and strap, plus a 7.4 V battery pack. Includes 2 packs of gel beads. For teens and adults; children under 14 need adult supervision, and eye protection must be worn. Looks realistic: don't carry or use it in public.

supplier.name: Dongcheng Rongsha Commercial Bank, Dongguan City

source.notes: Owner to confirm with the clearing agent that a realistic toy rifle can clear Nigerian Customs before any stock or publishing. Unit cost 70 CNY given by the owner for the colour-shift full kit bundle with 2 packs of gel beads (style 17/19); the page itself shows only a 40 to 120 CNY range across 19 styles. FX 222.63 from the page (8,905.32 / 40). Free shipping on orders over 60 CNY (within China). 60+ sold. Store return rate not shown. Colour-shift purple-blue full kit only; black, digital camo, black/tan and the drum-magazine version left out. Lithium 7.4 V battery pack: sea freight only (ships_by_air false). Package 7 x 16 cm per page, 5,600 cm3, 777 g, bag or colour box (odd figures: confirm). Supplier bundles a bonus sniper toy, a pistol toy and a colour-change target: left out of the listing and copy. Gel beads (2 packs) per the owner; a charger is not confirmed: not claimed. Supplier title and photo use brand and model names: none used here. Store photo is a cut-out from the 1440 px supplier image with text, size badge, bonus panel and accessory boxes removed. No safety certification shown or claimed.
